<!-- pr-reviewer: 48071efd4172c225ba80f0aae340ce2209e2a658 -->
Needs changes before merge. One reached heavy gate step failed.

The failure also occurs on unmodified main. This review found no defect in the changed source.

What looks good:

- The new division keeps the shared boundary nodes and checks the candidate deviation. The final plan still passes the existing deviation check.
- The thread-flank pin and the tolerance-fallback pin pass. The PR changes no fixtures, goldens, or UI files.

Local results:

I tested the trial merge with upstream main `61a817bed26bf42bf285638d5db337980bea6d0b` on macOS arm64. No GitHub runner ran. I disabled the inherited sccache wrapper after it stalled without build artifacts.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 10 steps passed; 43 tests passed; 2 heavy tests ignored |
| Kernel quick suites | `lib`: 13; `machining_mesh`: 7; `machining_mesh_bounds`: 5; `machining_mesh_open`: 6; `machining_mesh_parity`: 7; `machining_mesh_redivide`: 1; `machining_mesh_shortfalls`: 3 passed |
| App `import_step_thread` | 1 passed, including the four-turn flank pin |
| Clippy, kernel and app, `--all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | 247 steps; 1 failed; 34.6 minutes |
| Kernel heavy lane | 4 tests passed; no failure |
| Motion heavy lane | 56 tests passed; 2 known-fail checks failed as expected |
| App heavy lane | 40 tests passed; 1 failed; 6 known-fail checks failed as expected |

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --test step_agreement`: 23 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --test machining_mesh`: 7 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test feature_edge_g1_join`: 4 passed; the existing known-fail test stayed ignored. The heavy gate checked its expected failure separately.

Safety mutations:

I compiled temporary copies of `mesh_redivide_fill.rs` with `rustc --test`. I did not edit the reviewed source.

- Remove Lawson flips: the strip test failed with a 99.75375618711075 mm side. The unchanged copy passed before and after.
- Remove the last-ear check: the refusal test failed because the bow tie returned triangles. The unchanged copy passed before and after.

No goldens moved. The private 14-turn parts were not exercised.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:144`: resolve the reached heavy test failure before this PR becomes ready. `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` fails its platform count check. The result is `(3158, 3130, 1141)`. The macOS fallback at lines 193–198 expects different counts. I ran the exact release test on unmodified main `61a817bed` and got the same failure and counts. This is an existing platform pin problem, not a regression from this PR. Open issue #2371 tracks the macOS measurement. Keep the safety assertions when you correct the platform pin, then run the failed heavy step again.

Failure excerpt:

```text
panicked at crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:144:5:
the bore's path as the fix plans it: (3158, 3130, 1141)
test result: FAILED. 0 passed; 1 failed
```

The PR merges cleanly, but the reached heavy gate is red. The review label is `needs-rework`. The PR stays a draft.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the macOS arm64 bore count pin failure.

- Added the exact measured counts `(3158, 3130, 1141)` in `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs`. The existing safety assertions remain unchanged.
- Added `the_macos_arm64_bore_count_pin_is_exact`. It accepts the measured counts and rejects a one-count change in each direction for each value.
- Mutation check: the new pin passed. Removing the macOS branch made it fail. Restoring the branch made it pass.
- Reproduced the original failure. Then `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` passed in release with `--ignored --exact`.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: 12 steps, 45 tests passed, 4 ignored.
- Clippy passed for `camcraft-kernel` and `camcraft-app` with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`.

New head: `4be274f7958ff1b393fa67ffbc1172dc9d07f356`.

Please re-review this head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 4be274f7958ff1b393fa67ffbc1172dc9d07f356 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. The earlier requested change is complete.

What looks good:

- The new division keeps the shared boundary nodes and their direction. It keeps the candidate only after the deviation check passes.
- The whole plan still passes the existing deviation check before the mesh is accepted.
- The thread-flank test passes with its count, chord, edge, area, and axial-gap checks intact.
- The macOS arm64 count is now exact. The new test rejects a one-count change in either direction for each value.
- The earlier bore failure is fixed. Its safety assertions remain unchanged, and its release test passes.

Local results:

I reviewed the trial merge with upstream main `acd5b02d3e36a12745b11038012240781129d43c` on macOS arm64. I used the laws from that main. No GitHub runner ran. The inherited sccache wrapper was disabled. The reviewed source was not changed.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 12 steps passed; 45 tests passed; 4 ignored; 5.5 minutes |
| Kernel quick suites | `lib`: 13; `machining_mesh`: 7; `machining_mesh_bounds`: 5; `machining_mesh_open`: 6; `machining_mesh_parity`: 7; `machining_mesh_redivide`: 1; `machining_mesh_shortfalls`: 3 passed; `mesh_deviation_bench`: 1 ignored |
| App quick suites | `import_step_thread`: 1 passed; `pocket3d_hsm`: 2 passed, 2 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-kernel -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | 248 steps passed; no unexpected failure; 30.3 minutes |
| Kernel heavy lane | 4 tests passed |
| Motion heavy lane | 56 tests passed; 2 known-fail checks failed as expected |
| App heavy lane | 41 tests passed; 6 known-fail checks failed as expected |

The heavy gate ran `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`: 1 passed. It also ran all six shared-face finishing tests: 6 passed. The three slow finishing tests and the rotary parity tests passed.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --test step_agreement`: 23 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --test machining_mesh`: 7 passed, through the quick gate.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test feature_edge_g1_join`: 4 passed; 1 existing known-fail test ignored. The heavy gate checked that expected failure separately.

Safety mutations:

I compiled temporary copies of `mesh_redivide_fill.rs` with `rustc --test`.

- Remove Lawson flips: `a_long_strip_is_filled_with_short_sides_across_it` failed with a 99.75375618711075 mm side.
- Remove the last-ear check: `a_polygon_that_cannot_be_filled_is_refused` failed because the bow tie returned triangles.
- The unchanged copy passed all 3 tests before and after the mutations.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- No fixtures or goldens changed. There are no moved goldens to check line by line.
- No UI, dependency, build script, workflow, or process file changed.
- The private 14-turn parts were not exercised.
- The PR body still lists the heavy lanes as not exercised. The results above supply the completed review evidence.

The current head is `MERGEABLE`. The review label is `merge-ready`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
